messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "dose may drop to 25 mg every other day if potassium rises too high"
set: ["dose may drop to 25 mg every other day if potassium rises too high", "start at 25 mg every other day if eGFR is between 30 and 50 due to higher risk of high potassium", "12.5 mg dose may have less frequent low potassium compared to 25 mg", "take every other day", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "increase dosage by 25 mg every 3 days", "start with 25 mg a day", "dose can be raised in steps of 25 mg to 50 mg a day", "take prescribed dose every four to six hours at the same time every day", "call doctor at once if high blood potassium", "50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days", "may need to slowly decrease dose of other medication", "taper dose to 150 mg once a day", "may require dose increase if coadministered with other CYP2B6 inducers", "dose should be doubled every two weeks to the highest dose you tolerate, up to 200 mg once a day", "final dosage is 25 mg four times a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
